reason: I'd maybe poke at the free plan, but I'm not paying 99 € a month to let an unknown AI tool loose on my CRM and customer emails when Zapier and Make already run most of my automations. 'GDPR-compliant' in one line isn't enough, and I have no idea what 100 credits actually gets me.
objection: Where is my customer data stored and processed, which AI models see it, is there a DPA I can sign, and is it EU-hosted? Plus the integration list is just 'CRM, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365...' - does it really plug into HubSpot and my Make scenarios, or is it another silo?
would_change_my_mind: A published DPA with EU data hosting and a named sub-processor list, a real integration list including HubSpot and Make/Zapier, and a clear explanation of what a credit buys, so a free trial could prove it saves me hours in a week.
